add.k: A mutant who spits acidic vomit, recruited to X-Force
st: Zeitgeist joins X-Force, then lands in a wood chipper on its first jump, and his acid vomit kills Peter as he tries to help.

files.notes: He introduces himself at the tryouts ('I'm Zeitgeist... No, I spit acidic vomit'); transcript deadpool-2. His real name, Axel Cluney, is never said, so n is Zeitgeist. Wade later saves only Peter with Cable's device; Zeitgeist stays dead. X-Force is named on screen.

add.k: A mutant who can distort electrical fields
st: Bedlam shows off his power over electrical fields to join X-Force, but on its first jump the wind slams him into a bus.

files.notes: Wade introduces him ('Meet Bedlam') and he explains his power over electrical fields 'including the one inside your brain'; Wade later says 'Thank you, Bedlam' and 'That's right, Bedlam!'. Real name Jesse Aaronson is never said. The plane lines about Special Forces and 'Sugarbear' are not attributed by speaker in the subtitles, so they are left out.

add.k: A boy bred by Transigen who can control electricity
st: At Eden, Bobby asks Logan about his past, then turns his electric powers on the Reavers and helps the children kill Pierce.

files.notes: Named in dialogue during the Reaver attack ('Run, Bobby, run!'); transcript logan. His questions to Logan come from the MCU wiki page's traits; the subtitle file is incomplete there. Group follows the app's existing 'The Transigen children' (used for Laura in the Network); the screen never names the group, Rice only calls them 'X-23s'.

add.k: A girl bred by Transigen with power over ice
st: At Eden, Delilah chills a towel to cool the wounded Logan, then joins the children's fight against the Reavers and Pierce.

files.notes: Logan names her ('You got your Rebecca, Delilah...'); transcript logan. She freezes a wet cloth into an ice pack for Logan; the line 'Is this good, Rictor?' belongs to another child (Lizard Boy in the script), asking about the serum dose. Group as for the other Eden children: the app's 'The Transigen children', never named as such on screen.

add.k: A Transigen-bred mutant who leads the children at Eden
st: Rictor nurses Logan with a strength serum and plans the border crossing, then flips a truck onto X-24 and helps kill Pierce.

files.notes: Named in dialogue ('Is this good, Rictor?'); transcript logan. 'Julio Richter' is never said, so n is Rictor. Serum, gunpoint, truck and Pierce's death from Wikipedia's Logan plot. Group is the app's 'The Transigen children'; the screen never names it.

add.k: A farmer's wife who takes in Logan, Charles and Laura
st: Kathryn thanks Logan for rounding up her horses, invites his group to dinner and a room for the night, and is killed by X-24.

files.notes: She introduces herself ('I'm Kathryn'); the family name is said by Canewood's men ('Mr. Munson'). Group follows the app's existing 'The Munsons' farm' used for The Munsons; it is the family's own farm, not a named organization.

add.k: Will and Kathryn's son, a young barrel racer
st: Nate says he wants to travel too, shows Laura his rodeo trophies, lends her his music for the night, and is killed by X-24.

files.notes: Named by his mother ('He's my son Nate') and at dinner ('Why do you want to do that, Nate?'). 'Nathan' is never said, so n is Nate Munson. Group follows the app's 'The Munsons' farm'. Checker: he shows Laura his trophies ('Those are for barrel racing') and lets her keep his music for the night ('you can take them for tonight'), per the subtitles and the shooting script.

add.k: A farmer holding out against the Canewood company
st: Will hosts Logan's group, faces down Canewood's men at his water pump with Logan, and dies after pinning X-24 with his truck.

files.notes: Named by Kathryn ('I'm trying to get Will to take a vacation') and by the Canewood men ('Will Munson!'). Truck and death from Wikipedia's Logan plot. The claim that he shoots the real Logan first could not be confirmed from the sources, so it is left out. Group follows the app's 'The Munsons' farm'.

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Wade puts out a call for recruits and hires Zeitgeist at the tryouts after hearing he spits acidic vomit. Zeitgeist jumps with Wade's new X-Force onto the convoy and dies in a wood chipper on landing.
stages.whoA: The mercenary who recruits him to X-Force
stages.whoB: An acid-spitting recruit to X-Force

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Zeitgeist and Peter join X-Force together and jump from the plane onto the convoy. Peter lands safely and tries to pull Zeitgeist from a wood chipper, but Zeitgeist's acid vomit sprays him and kills him.
stages.whoA: A teammate who dies trying to save him
stages.whoB: The teammate whose acid kills him

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Bedlam and Zeitgeist both pass Wade's X-Force tryouts and ride the plane to the convoy. The high winds kill them both on the jump, Bedlam against a bus and Zeitgeist in a wood chipper.
stages.whoA: A fellow X-Force recruit
stages.whoB: A fellow X-Force recruit

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Bedlam answers Wade's call for recruits and shows how he can distort electrical fields, and Wade takes him on. On the plane Wade cheers him on, but the wind throws Bedlam into a bus.
stages.whoA: The mercenary who recruits him to X-Force
stages.whoB: A recruit who can distort electrical fields

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Bedlam gets to know Peter on the plane while Peter worries about the high winds. Both jump onto the convoy, and Bedlam is killed when the wind sends him into a bus.
stages.whoA: A nervous X-Force teammate
stages.whoB: A pumped up X-Force teammate

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Rictor and the Eden children nurse Logan after he collapses and give him a serum that makes him stronger. When the Reavers attack, Logan takes the serum to protect them, and Rictor fights beside him until X-24 kills Logan.
stages.whoA: The old mutant he nurses at Eden
stages.whoB: The young leader of the Eden children

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Laura reaches Eden and rejoins Rictor and the other children who escaped Transigen. They flee the Reavers together, kill Pierce, and bury Logan before heading for the border.
stages.whoA: A fellow Transigen child
stages.whoB: The leader of her Transigen friends

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Pierce's Reavers hunt the children on their way to the border, and Pierce holds Rictor at gunpoint. Rictor and the others turn their powers on him and kill him.
stages.whoA: The cyborg hunter who catches him
stages.whoB: An Eden child who helps kill him

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: X-24 joins the hunt for the Eden children and fights Logan in the woods. Rictor flips a truck onto him with his powers, but X-24 breaks free and kills Logan.
stages.whoA: The clone he buries under a truck
stages.whoB: A boy who drops a truck on him

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: At Eden, Bobby is eager to hear about Logan and the X-Men. When the Reavers come, Logan fights for the children and Bobby uses his powers beside him.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he looks up to
stages.whoB: An Eden boy who idolizes the X-Men

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Bobby is one of the Transigen children Laura rejoins at Eden. They run from the Reavers together, kill Pierce, and bury Logan.
stages.whoA: A fellow Transigen child
stages.whoB: A fellow Transigen child

stages.whoA: The cyborg hunting the children
stages.whoB: An Eden boy who helps kill him

stages.title: Logan

stages.whoA: The leader of the Eden children
stages.whoB: A boy who controls electricity

stages.whoB: An Eden girl who helps kill him

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Kathryn and her husband Will host Logan's group for dinner, where she teases him about never taking a vacation. That night X-24 attacks the farm and kills them both.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife

stages.title: Logan

stages.whoA: Her son
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Logan, calling himself James, helps Kathryn round up her loose horses, and she insists his family stay for dinner and the night. While Logan is out with Will, X-24 kills her.
stages.whoA: A stranger who helps her family
stages.whoB: A farmer's wife who takes them in

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Kathryn welcomes Charles, introduced as Logan's father, into her home and gives him a room for the night. Charles calls it the most perfect night he has had in years before X-24 attacks.
stages.whoA: A guest she gives a room for the night
stages.whoB: The woman who welcomes him home

stages.whoA: The clone who kills her
stages.whoB: A woman he kills at the farm

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: At dinner Will asks who would run the farm if they traveled, while Nate says he wants to travel like the guests. X-24 kills Nate in the attack, and Will dies fighting back.
stages.whoA: His father
stages.whoB: His son

stages.title: Logan

stages.whoA: A silent girl he shares his music with
stages.whoB: The farm boy who lends her his music

stages.title: Logan

stages.whoA: The clone who kills him
stages.whoB: A boy he kills at the farm

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Logan goes with Will to restart his water pump and drives off the Canewood men who block it. When X-24 attacks the farm, Will pins the clone with his truck and dies.
stages.whoA: The guest who backs him against Canewood
stages.whoB: The farmer he backs against Canewood

stages.title: Logan
